default_path: cut_union_spec defaults to None; old footprint/version/containment logic remains, and undeclared union action/microstep sidecars are refused. New certificate version appears only under explicit union spec.
proof_semantics: Affine subcells tile the original cell. All eight vertices of each added leaf must be inside one current capsule. Convexity therefore supplies the intended conservative geometric certificate per leaf; different original corners cannot be assigned to different capsules to hide an interior gap.
Verifier uses its own segment projection arithmetic and bit-to-subcell reconstruction. It imports only shared immutable metadata digest support, not producing cut-union geometry/coverage functions.
Partial leaf additions require a previously free six-face neighbor or declared outside-image boundary. Whole-cell shortcut is independently rechecked and must remove a currently connected cell.

Outer checker validates original remaining tissue against the entire swept shaft before adding coverage or removing cells; current removals cannot supply their own shaft clearance. It separately preserves hard/domain/access/full-tool checks and independently updates free-space connectivity only after removal.
Probe mode cannot add coverage, claim leaf work/progress or remove tissue. Aspiration with neither removal nor new coverage cannot be committed as progress.

Full native cells remain occupied and receive zero removal volume until all leaves are certified. This is an explicit idealized cumulative cutting/evacuation abstraction, not force/tissue/device validation.

resolved_finding.previous_behavior: Leaf proof could fill an exposed cell without removing it; a later empty witness could remove that full ledger cell outside the current active capsule. Past geometric coverage alone did not preserve native removal timing.
resolved_finding.reason_sufficient: Accepted ledger states contain only partial masks. A removed cell must become complete now using a current executed-capsule proof; no full mask can survive for later unrelated reward attribution.
resolved_finding.repair: Reject any full ledger mask absent from current removed set before accepting the microstep. A source regression now refuses the full-bank step.
resolved_finding.title: Full coverage could be banked then evacuated by a remote action

resource_scope: Depth1..3 bounds each cell to8..512 bits; tracked accepted ledger cells<=4096; witness rows<=8192 per action; leaf accounting cap<=4194304; independent proof vertex batches<=64 leaves.

leaf_tests is asserted at least the added-leaf proof count and summed against declared cap. The checker does not replay unsuccessful producer leaf tests, so this is not independent certification of exact producer work.

Resident ledger capacity is now checked before adding a new key, so even malformed input cannot make the internal sparse ledger exceed max_tracked_cells. The after-loop check remains defense in depth.
No total-history deadline/cancellation is added inside leaf arithmetic; outer per-microstep cancellation and owned process limits remain necessary for global timing/RSS claims.
